meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 把 Telegram、Slack 等消息渠道接到 agent 组上,处理会话隔离级别,添加新的渠道群组,并列出已接、已配置未接和未配置的渠道与有权限的用户。设置后可随时调整接线。
howto.when: 在添加渠道之后、初始化配置过程中,或想单独重新调整渠道接线时接管。实例还没有 owner 时,它会先让你运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 看看现在哪些渠道接好了,哪些还没接
say.note: 输出 agent 组、已接/未接渠道和特权用户清单

say.text: 把这个新的 Telegram 群接到现有的 agent 组上
say.note: 先问隔离方式,再注册接线

say.text: 把这个渠道从旧 agent 组换到另一个组
say.note: 删旧接线建新接线,旧会话留在原组

howto.what_en: It wires messaging channels to agent groups, handles isolation levels, adds new channel groups, and lists which channels are wired, configured-but-unwired, or not configured, plus privileged users.
howto.when_en: Used after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure. If no owner exists yet, it first points you to /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which aren't
say_en.note: Lists agent groups, wired/unwired channels, privileged users

say_en.text: Wire this new Telegram group to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Asks the isolation question, then registers the wiring

say_en.text: Move this channel from its old agent group to another one
say_en.note: Deletes old wiring, creates new; old sessions stay put
